title: Logic Analyzer Trace Reader
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Logic Analyzer
I2C
Debugging
Signal Integrity
Button Bounce
description: Interactive p5.js logic analyzer trace reader with SCL and SDA traces and an I2C decode band. Students click parts of four captured waveforms (a good OLED write, a NACK, slow edges from weak pull-ups, and button bounce) and diagnose each fault with feedback.

educational.topic: Reading I2C waveforms with a logic analyzer
learningObjectives: Interpret an I2C waveform, identifying the start, address, R/W bit, ACK, data and stop
Diagnose a missing acknowledgment from the ninth clock pulse
Distinguish a wiring fault (weak pull-ups) and contact bounce from a healthy signal

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Diagnosis quiz on realistic captured data
keyQuestions: What happens on the ninth clock pulse of every I2C byte?
How can you tell slow edges from a healthy signal?
Why does one button press count as several?
commonMisconceptions: The controller generates the ACK (the receiving device pulls SDA low)
If the bytes decode correctly the wiring must be fine (slow edges can still cause errors at higher speeds)
assessmentOpportunities: Decode an address and data bytes by hand
Diagnose each capture and name the fix

controls.label: Click the waveform
controls.description: Names the clicked part of the signal.

controls.label: Check
controls.description: Gives feedback on the chosen diagnosis.

controls.label: Scroll
controls.description: Pans along the trace when it is wider than the screen.
